scope: 68 new nonsecret setting values, TLS aggregate; 63 sensitive/excluded values metadata only

query_sources.values: SELECT name,setting,unit,vartype,source,context,pending_restart,md5(name||chr(31)||setting||chr(31)||coalesce(unit,'')) AS value_md5 FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings WHERE name IN ('application_name','authentication_timeout','client_connection_check_interval','client_encoding','createrole_self_grant','cron.timezone','data_directory_mode','DateStyle','debug_io_direct','default_table_access_method','default_tablespace','default_text_search_config','escape_string_warning','file_extend_method','jit_provider','lc_messages','lc_monetary','lc_numeric','lc_time','local_preload_libraries','log_destination','log_file_mode','log_hostname','log_line_prefix','log_replication_commands','log_temp_files','log_timezone','max_connections','max_files_per_process','max_index_keys','output_plugin_libraries','pg_net.database_name','pg_net.ttl','pgaudit.log','pgaudit.log_level','pgaudit.role','pgtle.clientauth_num_parallel_workers','pgtle.enable_clientauth','pgtle.enable_password_check','plpgsql_check.profiler','plpgsql_check.profiler_max_shared_chunks','plpgsql.extra_errors','plpgsql.extra_warnings','port','post_auth_delay','pre_auth_delay','remove_temp_files_after_crash','reserved_connections','restrict_nonsystem_relation_kind','search_path','server_encoding','server_version','session_preload_libraries','shared_preload_libraries','ssl_ciphers','ssl_ecdh_curve','ssl_library','ssl_passphrase_command_supports_reload','standard_conforming_strings','superuser_reserved_connections','syslog_ident','temp_file_limit','temp_tablespaces','TimeZone','timezone_abbreviations','trace_connection_negotiation','vacuum_cost_page_dirty','wal_consistency_checking') ORDER BY name
query_sources.remaining_metadata: SELECT name,vartype,source,context FROM pg_catalog.pg_settings ORDER BY name
query_sources.tls_aggregate: SELECT coalesce(version,'NONE') AS tls_version,coalesce(cipher,'NONE') AS cipher,count(*)::int AS sessions FROM pg_catalog.pg_stat_ssl WHERE ssl GROUP BY version,cipher ORDER BY sessions DESC,tls_version,cipher
